errors.evidence: The description states that the bars for both "Друго" (Other) and "Осъществяване на бартерни сделки" (Carrying out barter transactions) are positioned at a value of around 15. While the bar for "Друго" is indeed around 15, the bar for "Осъществяване на бартерни сделки" is visibly higher, at a value of approximately 20-25.

The description correctly identifies that the bars are colored either red-brown or blue, but it fails to mention the rule or pattern behind this coloring. The reference description correctly points out that the colors distinguish between categories with more than 100 responses (red) and those with fewer than 100 responses (blue). This is a key visual feature for grouping the data.
